caseName: Rowell v. Metro. Life Ins. Co.
caseNameFull: Brandon ROWELL v. METROPOLITAN LIFE INSURANCE COMPANY.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioner allowed until June 16, 2015, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
